Sutter, D., Werner, M., Zappone, A. and Mazzotti, M. (2013). Developing CCS into a Realistic Option in a Country's Energy Strategy. Energy Procedia, 37, 6562-6570. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.egypro.2013.06.588

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. GHGT-11 summary of the Swiss CARMA project (2009-2012) on CCS in Switzerland: geological storage potential of the Swiss Molasse Basin (theoretical about 2,600 Mt CO2, of which about 700 Mt in the Upper Muschelkalk aquifer, 800-2500 m depth, porosity about 20%), induced seismicity, public perception, the absent legal framework, and a proposed Ketzin-style pilot injection (max 100,000 t). Its only other numbers are sector context: Swiss electricity 57% hydro and 38% nuclear; up to seven NGCC plants needed; a 400 MW NGCC emits about 1 Mt CO2/yr; grid modernisation 18 billion CHF to 2050. It prints NO cost, energy or capture figures. Requested in to-get.csv (cited by Habert et al. 2020, ref 139) for "CCS effect on cement price (+50-100%)": that figure is not in this paper (it does not discuss cement at all), so the Habert citation appears to point to the wrong CARMA paper; the cement-price effect needs another source (e.g. gardarsdottir_2019_001 or the CEMCAP results).
